shared_elements: plant or vegetal motif (dotted/rosette-like elements vs floral rosettes)
justification: The only shared content is the human/humanoid figure with raised arms, which is universal, plus loosely comparable small vegetal/dotted accents; A shows dozens of tiny stick-like silhouetted figures scattered in a lively crowd scene with bows and animals, while B shows one large winged bearded figure in strict profile tending a stylised plant with rosettes. There is no correspondence in composition, scale, relationships, or rendering conventions (rough monochrome silhouettes versus detailed low-relief modelling of feathers, beard and hands).}
